# Digital twin run — Front-end workflow redesign (single-pass clearance)

*Model: `TWIN-BASE-10B` v1.0 (2026-07) — Archetype IDN — $10B NPR, single-instance Epic on AWS, Snowflake EDW, Databricks lakehouse. Horizon 36 months. Generated by `twin.py`; do not hand-edit.*

> Registration-to-clearance redesign: one consolidated pre-service contact per account (pre-reg + eligibility + estimate + counseling), auth submitted at order entry, POS collection scripted with an accurate estimate in hand. Tests pure workflow change: fewer, richer touches; defects prevented at source; better patient financial experience.
